brief_text: ten dominoes stand in a row; the first is tipped over and knocks down the rest, and every domino ends tilted at least 15 degrees from upright

usage.text:
Ten dominoes, each 10 cm tall, stand 6 cm apart along +x. The keyframe starts `domino1` rotating about its front bottom edge. It falls into the next one and the chain topples down the row. The last domino falls flat. The others end leaning on their neighbours, well past 15°.

verdict.what_happens: domino1 starts tipping forward from the keyframe velocity, hits domino2 at 0.12 s, and the chain propagates down the row, reaching domino10 at 0.86 s. By 1.09 s all dominoes are at rest: dominoes 1-8 lean at about 71 deg on their neighbours, domino9 at 73 deg, and domino10 lies flat at 90 deg, unchanged through 6 s.

usage.text:
The keyframe sets domino1 tipping forward. It hits domino2 at 0.12 s, and each domino strikes the next in turn until domino10 is hit at 0.86 s. By 1.09 s every domino is at rest. Dominoes 1–8 lean at about 71° from upright, each resting on its neighbour. Domino9 sits at 73° and domino10 lies flat at 90°. Every domino is far past 15°, and nothing moves for the remaining five seconds.
